content: I've created a draft PR #39356 for changing a ι₁-grading on a monoid/module/ring/… to a ι₂-grading by “pushing forward” along a map f : ι₁ → ι₂. For example, this should allow viewing an ℕ-grading object as naturally ℤ-graded or ZMod 2-graded. I've also just opened PR #39607, which is supposed to be a first step towards merging this.
